thread:
Maria: Quick follow-up from the routing postmortem — consolidating action items for the LB/DNS retry storms and cross-region TLS retries. Can owners ack and add ETA?

Ajay: Ack. I'll own the routing fallback policy change (make failover less aggressive between regions). Plan: update policy, run canary, then prod rollout. ETA: initial canary by Tue EOD.

Devon: I can handle rollout testing and the smoke suite. Need Ajay's policy diff to validate. Will coordinate with eng-sre for traffic shaping.

IncidentBot: Incident 2025-11-03 closed. Postmortem: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/routing-retry-storm-2025 (auto-attached)

Sam: Two notes from the postmortem logs — we saw a pattern of TLS handshake errors with SNI fallback when LB routed to older instances. Suggest adding a targeted probe for cross-region TLS errors + SNI mismatch rate.

Priya: I'll take the monitoring/alerting work. Proposed tasks: add Datadog metric, new alert (p95 TLS handshake failures > 0.5% over 5m), and dashboard panel. ETA: draft alert + dashboard by next Thu.

Leo: Heads-up: several Dedicated customers touched by the cross-region failovers. We'll need a customer impact note and to check if any pinned routes were overridden during rollback. I'll compile a short list and share.

Ajay: Pushing draft routing config for review:
```yaml
routing_policy:
  prefer_local: true
  cross_region_failover:
    max_retries: 2
    backoff_ms: 200
    disable_aggressive_failover: true
```
Link to diff: https://git.internal/redwood/routing/+/2345

Devon: Running canary with -10% traffic to region-b now. I'll post logs if any TLS handshakes spike.

Maria: Action items summary (from thread):
- Ajay: update routing fallback policy + PR (ETA Tue EOD)
- Devon: canary + smoke tests (ETA Wed morning)
- Priya: monitoring & alerting (ETA Thu)
- Leo: customer impact list & comms draft (ETA Wed EOD)
- Sam: write TLS/SNI repro case and attach logs (ETA Tue)

Sam: Repro note: observed TLS error sample "handshake failed: SNI mismatch" on 10.1.2.34 -> region-b-lb. Logs attached in the postmortem.

Priya: Datadog query I'll add: 
```
avg:trace.tls.handshake_failures{env:prod,region:*}.by{region}.rollup(sum,60)
```
Alert: when ratio(handshake_failures / total_tls_connections) > 0.005 for 5m.

Leo: Compiled customer list: cust-phi, fintech-partner, retail-eu. I'll DM account owners and propose a brief note.

Ajay: Small follow-up: need a quick config tweak to LB healthcheck to prefer TLS SNI validation first. Adding to PR.

Devon: Canary ran for 90m, no observable error spike. Logs: small bump in retries but TLS handshakes stable. Proceeding to 50% traffic ramp tomorrow at 08:00 PT.

Maria: Great. Please keep this thread updated with final PR link, alert IDs, and customer comms. Will mark as tracked in the postmortem remediation tracker.

Priya: Draft alert created — ID: DD-4873. I'll attach playbook for on-call runbook.

Ajay: PR merged to main with config and healthcheck tweak: https://git.internal/redwood/routing/+/2350. Rolling to prod now.

Devon: Prod ramp completed, monitoring shows TLS handshake failure ratio stabilized to <0.1%. No active incidents after ramp.

Maria: Thanks everyone :thumbsup: I'll update the postmortem doc with owners+ETAs and close out action items once all checkboxes done.
